day_shape: 78 items: UK joins multinational Strait of Hormuz mission with drones/jets/warship, NYT/ToI report Iran has regained access to ~30 missile sites, Pentagon puts Iran-war cost near $29bn, Iran executes alleged Mossad spy Ehsan Afrashteh, and TankerTrackers logs 28 days of zero Iranian seaborne crude exports.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz multinational mission
threads.summary: The UK MoD announced a contribution of drones, jets and a warship to the multinational Strait of Hormuz mission at a virtual defence ministers' summit, with South Korea's defence minister saying Seoul is reviewing a phased contribution. Khamenei's office posted that 'a new chapter in the Persian Gulf and the Strait of Hormuz is being written' two months after what it called America's failed campaign, while a Times of Israel piece framed the Hormuz standoff as an Iran-Trump test of nerve.

threads.label: Iran missile sites and war cost accounting
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post and Times of Israel, citing a New York Times report quoting senior US officials, said Washington believes Iran has regained access to a majority of its missile sites, with roughly 30 along the Strait of Hormuz. The Pentagon said the US cost of the Iran war is approaching $29 billion, and Defense Secretary Hegseth faced fresh congressional questioning on the war.

threads.label: Regional moves around Iran war
threads.summary: Times of Israel and the Jerusalem Post reported that Saudi Arabia covertly launched strikes on Iran during the war, Kuwait announced the capture of IRGC operatives who allegedly tried to invade Bubiyan Island, and US Ambassador Huckabee confirmed Israel sent Iron Dome batteries to the UAE during the conflict. Australia sanctioned seven Iranian individuals and four entities, and a Bahraini court handed a life sentence to a woman convicted of contacts with the Revolutionary Guards.

threads.label: Trump messaging on Iran nuclear file
threads.summary: Trump told a radio interviewer he is confident Iran will stop enriching uranium and hand its material to the US, and said Americans' financial struggles are not a factor in his decision-making on preventing an Iranian nuclear weapon. He also said the US would 'finish the job' against Iran 'peacefully or otherwise,' according to Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post posts.

threads.label: Iran economy under blockade and blackout
threads.summary: Iran International, citing TankerTrackers, reported 28 consecutive days with no successful Iranian seaborne crude exports under the US naval blockade, and quoted a provincial official saying handwoven carpet exports once worth $2.5bn have 'virtually stopped.' The Jerusalem Post cited New York Times reporting that Iranian officials estimate two million people have lost work directly or indirectly because of the war and prolonged internet blackout, with further Iran International messages describing layoffs and coerced pro-government posts to restore internet access.

threads.label: Execution and judicial cases inside Iran
threads.summary: Iranian state media and Times of Israel reported the execution of Ehsan Afrashteh on charges of spying for Israel's Mossad, with Defa Press describing multiple alleged Mossad contacts before sentencing was upheld by the Supreme Court. Iran International reported the Supreme Court rejected poet Peyman Farahavar's request for judicial review, leaving him at risk of execution.

threads.label: Hezbollah and Lebanon front
threads.summary: The IDF said it had carried out a weeklong raid on Hezbollah sites beyond Lebanon's Litani River, and the Jerusalem Post reported Hezbollah fired a surface-to-air missile at an Israeli fighter jet. Hezbollah chief Naim Qassem said an Iran-US deal was the best chance to end Israeli 'aggression' in Lebanon and called for ending direct Israel-Lebanon talks, while a Walla report cited by JPost described a Hezbollah plan to 'occupy Beirut' against pro-normalisation figures.

events.summary_en: Ehsan Afrashte, son of Mostafa, who was arrested and tried on charges of espionage and providing intelligence to the Zionist regime, after completing the full criminal proceedings and the confirmation and ratification of the sentence by the Supreme Court, this morning faced the consequence of his actions and was hanged.
